states.name: INIT
states.description: Production record created; nothing generated yet.

states.name: RESEARCHING
states.description: Research engine gathering timestamped evidence.

states.name: RESEARCH_VERIFIED
states.description: Claims linked to sources; evidence thresholds met.

states.name: CONCEPT_SELECTED
states.description: Strategy decision recorded; concept locked.

states.name: SCRIPTING
states.description: Script agent generating script versions.

states.name: SCRIPT_VERIFIED
states.description: Script passes schema, factual and policy validation.

states.name: STORYBOARDING
states.description: Storyboard agent generating scene plan.

states.name: STORYBOARD_VERIFIED
states.description: Storyboard structurally valid and script-aligned.

states.name: ASSET_GENERATION
states.description: Visual assets generated or sourced.

states.name: ASSETS_READY
states.description: All required assets present with GREEN rights.

states.name: AUDIO_GENERATION
states.description: Voice and music tracks generated.

states.name: AUDIO_READY
states.description: Audio passes deterministic technical checks.

states.name: EDITING
states.description: MediaWorker composing the candidate render.

states.name: CANDIDATE_RENDERED
states.description: Render artifact exists, hashed and manifest-consistent.

states.name: TECHNICAL_QA
states.description: Container, codec, duration, decode integrity.

states.name: VISUAL_QA
states.description: Black/freeze frames, safe areas, visual coherence.

states.name: AUDIO_QA
states.description: Silence, clipping, loudness, A/V sync, intelligibility.

states.name: CONTENT_QA
states.description: Factual accuracy, tone, policy and claim substantiation.

states.name: RETENTION_QA
states.description: Hook strength and retention heuristics.

states.name: COMPLIANCE_QA
states.description: Rights, disclosure, synthetic labelling, platform policy.

states.name: SCORING
states.description: Aggregate scoring against configured thresholds.

states.name: REWORK
states.description: Targeted regeneration of the earliest invalid DAG node.

states.name: FINAL_VERIFIED
states.description: All gates passed; production manifest sealed.

states.name: READY_TO_PUBLISH
states.description: Publication preflight passed for at least one target.

states.name: PUBLISHING
states.description: Publication intents dispatched to platform adapters.

states.name: PUBLICATION_PROCESSING
states.description: At least one target accepted and is processing.

states.name: PUBLICATION_VERIFIED
states.description: All required targets verified by authoritative evidence.

states.name: ARCHIVED
states.description: Lifecycle closed; artifacts under retention policy.

states.name: BLOCKED
states.description: Halted by policy, budget, rights, credential or kill switch.

states.name: FAILED
states.description: Permanently failed; not resumable without a new production.

states.name: CANCELLED
states.description: Cancelled by an authorised operator.

states.name: UNKNOWN_EXTERNAL_STATE
states.description: An external side effect may or may not have taken place.

rollup_rules.rule: production.state = PUBLICATION_VERIFIED iff every publication row whose target is marked required has state = VERIFIED, established only via OFFICIAL_API, OFFICIAL_DASHBOARD or OPERATOR_CONFIRMATION evidence (V31-06).
production.state = PUBLICATION_PROCESSING iff at least one required publication is in {UPLOAD_REQUESTED, UPLOADED, PROCESSING, PUBLISHED} and none is in UNKNOWN_EXTERNAL_STATE.
production.state = UNKNOWN_EXTERNAL_STATE iff at least one required publication is in UNKNOWN_EXTERNAL_STATE.
production.state = FAILED via T-032 iff every required publication is in {FAILED, REJECTED}.
A partial outcome (some targets VERIFIED, some FAILED) holds the production in PUBLICATION_PROCESSING and raises an operator notification; it is never silently promoted to PUBLICATION_VERIFIED.
